prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body DEMON TRANSFORMATION concept of the supplied Runelord Abyssal Seraph Warlock. Input image is the user-selected identity AND rendering reference. He must be immediately recognizably the same character: sharp red hood, angular pointed black face mask, narrow amber eyes, round gold ruby throat clasp, diamond ruby belt ornament, long red/black gold-edged robes, slender elegant build. Much more powerful and demonic, NOT muscular, bulky, ripped, bare-chested or armored like a tank. Preserve narrow shoulders/waist and long covered limbs. Serious clean 2D cel-shaded game art, broad flat shapes, crisp faceted hard shadows and restrained highlights, quiet surfaces, no realistic anatomy, painterly textures, PBR, photographic or 3D rendering. One figure only, entire wings horns robe and feet inside canvas with generous margin. Shallow three-quarter view facing screen right. Genuine transparent background, no scenery, labels, ground, smoke backdrop or text. CONCEPT 1: THE INFERNAL SOVEREIGN. Transform his two horns into a sweeping four-pronged obsidian crown grown around the same red hood; original two tall central horns remain recognizable with a shorter swept-back outer pair. Two enormous regal bat wings, black structural bones, deep crimson membranes with a few bold ember-red channels. Original mask gains subtly fang-shaped cheek edges, eyes burn amber. Robe evolves into regal pointed mantle and long clean split panels with the recognizable gold trim and gems. Long fine black talons. Upright calm commanding stance, arms loosely crossed like the reference. Power comes from crown, imposing wingspan and controlled presence. Clear substantial transformation beyond just costume recolor.
